footoodle.title: Subscribe to Collabore
footoodle.description:
Collabore opens the doors to developers and enthusiasts. Turn your static pages service into dynamic ones.

Through a simple yet powerful interface you can modify, review and create new posts, add plugins and apps to your pages or embed your own extensions.

All of this through open source code designed to be extended. Use the built-in authentication system so Collabore users can sign up on your page in a few clicks and, best of all, authenticate automatically in your page's plugins and apps.

Be part of this collaborative system, sign up now!

about.title: About
about.p1: Hello, I'm Lauro Moraes "aka" Subversivo58 and this site is my digital lab and personal blog.
about.p2: Here I publish content about technology trends, cyberculture and web-focused programming such as PWAs, Single Page Apps and the use of modern JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3 APIs
about.p3: I'm passionate about functional programming, design patterns and topics such as web decentralization ... blockchain and web cryptography are constant themes here.
about.p4: This is also where I publish my experiments and share my code and small working snippets, besides expressing my opinions on various subjects, a bit of geek culture and this lifestyle.
about.p5: Feel free to explore the blog's content and join our community.

dpo.heading: Data Protection Officer (DPO)
dpo.intro1: In compliance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD - Law No. 13,709/2018), we provide the contact of our Data Protection Officer.
dpo.intro2: The DPO is the person responsible for mediating communication between the Site, data subjects (you) and the Brazilian National Data Protection Authority (ANPD).
dpo.deadline: Response time: Up to 30 days, in accordance with the regulation applicable to small-scale processing agents.
dpo.rights1: To exercise any of your rights under Art. 18 of the LGPD (such as confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, deletion, among others), simply send an email to the address above.
dpo.rights2: To speed up the service, we suggest that you include in the subject or body of the email:
dpo.list2: The right you wish to exercise (e.g. data deletion, access, etc.);
dpo.list3: Details that may help us locate your data in our systems.
dpo.policies: For more details on how we handle your data, see our General Policy and our Privacy Policy.
